rules.title: Gurez: identity proof and photocopies at check posts
rules.detail: Indian citizens need no permit for Dawar but show original identity proof at Tragbal, Razdan Pass and Dawar, and leave photocopies. Reported by an operator; no order found.
rules.set_by: Indian Army and Jammu and Kashmir Police

rules.title: Gurez: foreign citizens need clearance from Bandipora
rules.detail: An operator says foreigners apply to the Deputy Commissioner's office a week or more ahead with passport and visa copies. Another guide says access may be refused. No order found.

rules.title: Beyond Dawar: local permission may be needed
rules.detail: Villages near the Line of Control, such as those in Tulail, may need permission or registration at Dawar police station. Rules are confirmed on the day. No order found.

rules.title: Cut-off times at Tragbal and Kanzalwan; chains in snow
rules.detail: Traffic must pass the control points at Tragbal and Kanzalwan before set cut-off times, which the sources do not state. After snow no vehicle runs without anti-skid chains.

gaps: Whether Gurez is open to non-local tourists on 28 September 2026 was not confirmed; in February 2026 it was listed as awaiting snow clearance before reopening.
No official page found for any Gurez permit or registration rule; all come from operators.
Sources conflict on whether Indian citizens need a permit; one operator guide mentions a permit, another says identity proof is enough.
The cut-off times at Tragbal and Kanzalwan are not stated in any source opened.
Opening dates for 2021 to 2024 and 2026, and closing dates for every year, were not found.
No source says whether motorcycles were allowed when the road opened in any year.
No road number found for the Bandipora to Gurez road.
Only one rider video could be checked; a second, on crossing Razdan Pass in April 2025, could not be read.
